security_audit.summary: The skill has expected third-party network calls to BrowserAct and handles BROWSERACT_API_KEY as a credential. Most markdown backtick and system-reconnaissance detections are false positives from documentation formatting or normal error handling. The main concerns are direct API key collection guidance and an unvalidated marketplace URL.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide API keys in chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through secret storage or environment configuration.
Allow only known Amazon marketplace domains before forwarding the value to BrowserAct.
Document that the skill sends requests and a BrowserAct bearer token to api.browseract.com.

content.value_statement: Amazon sellers need current Buy Box and seller data for specific listings. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow by ASIN and returns structured listing details.
actual_capabilities: Starts a BrowserAct Amazon Buy Box workflow for a supplied ASIN.
Polls BrowserAct task status until completion or timeout.
Returns product title, Buy Box owner, price, currency, and availability when provided by the workflow.
Reports other seller prices, shipping fees, ratings, and fulfillment methods when available.
Handles missing or invalid BrowserAct API key errors with user-facing messages.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key in BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Depends on BrowserAct workflow availability and Amazon page access.
Does not store historical price data or schedule recurring checks.
Does not validate that marketplace URLs are Amazon domains.

use_cases.description: Review who owns the Buy Box and compare the current price for one ASIN.

use_cases.title: Prepare Competitor Snapshots
use_cases.description: Collect seller prices, shipping fees, ratings, and fulfillment methods for client marketplace reviews.

use_cases.title: Review Listing Health
use_cases.description: Confirm availability, seller details, and pricing signals before catalog or replenishment decisions.

prompt_templates.prompt: Check ASIN B005O2ZU68 on https://amazon.co.uk/. List the Buy Box owner and the top competing sellers by total price.

prompt_templates.title: Review Fulfillment Signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the monitor for this ASIN and highlight fulfillment methods, seller ratings, and shipping fees that affect Buy Box competition.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Audit Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: For the supplied ASIN and marketplace URL, run the monitor, identify pricing gaps, seller reputation risks, and follow-up checks for our team.

output_examples.output: The skill reports an authorization error and asks the user to update the BrowserAct API key securely.

best_practices: Store BrowserAct API keys in environment variables or approved secret storage.
Use official Amazon marketplace domains and record the requested region.
Confirm that automated data collection follows Amazon and BrowserAct terms.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat when secure secret storage is available.
Do not use non-Amazon URLs as marketplace inputs.
Do not treat one lookup as a complete trend analysis.

faq.question: What does this skill monitor?
faq.answer: It monitors Amazon Buy Box details, seller prices, ratings, availability, and fulfillment data for a supplied ASIN.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to authenticate with the BrowserAct workflow API.

faq.question: Does it scrape Amazon directly from my machine?
faq.answer: No. The local script calls BrowserAct, which runs the configured workflow and returns results.

faq.question: Can it track price history?
faq.answer: No. It performs a single lookup and does not store results or schedule future checks.

faq.question: Which marketplaces are supported?
faq.answer: The documentation shows Amazon marketplace URLs, such as United States and United Kingdom domains.

faq.question: What should users do with secrets?
faq.answer: Users should configure keys through environment variables or secure secret storage, not plain chat messages.
